GraceRequirements.Annotation: Source repository for the static HTML portal of the AI Competence Center (AICC) at O!Bank Kyrgyzstan; the portal projects the center's strategy, statement of intent, roadmap, knowledge base, and lifecycle-management processes.
GraceRequirements.Keywords: aicc, o-bank, kyrgyzstan, genai, ai-competence-center, portal, static-site, knowledge-base, roadmap, strategy

Goals.Goal: Present the AICC's strategy, statement of intent, roadmap, knowledge base, and process and knowledge information as one portal that mirrors the center's activities and responsibilities.
Support GenAI adoption across O!Bank business functions by making AICC guidance and lifecycle-management information easy to find.
Develop and shape the portal in this repository, then render a clean static output to a separate deployment repository.

Users.User: O!Bank staff across business functions adopting GenAI
AICC team members who maintain portal content and lifecycle information

Constraints.Constraint: The published portal is static HTML; it needs no server-side runtime.
This repository is the development source; the deployment repository receives only rendered output and is never edited as a second source.
Portal content is bank-internal or public-facing status is undecided; confirm audience and data classification before publishing any content.
